svg.title: Solaris icon set sketch — 16x16 pixel grid
svg.text: Icon set sketch · 16×16 pixel grid · one ink + 40% dim ink
Authored on whole pixels: crisp at 1×/2×/3× in the launcher and at integer GUI scale in game. Shown 4× with grid, then actual 1× and 2×.
Rules: label always visible except the universal tool set (close, back, more, copy, search, settings) which carries a tooltip on hover AND focus. Never text inside an icon-sized button.
In game, vanilla screens keep their vanilla sprites (recipe book, page arrows, tabs). These icons are for Solaris-owned surfaces only.
Original artwork by DesignOpus, 2026-10-23 — sketch quality; final set needs a pixel artist pass and a localisation/hit-target review.
